description.value:
Frequency once per round

Range 30 feet

Targets 1 ally

Reduce the target's frightened condition by 1, or end one despair or morale effect of your level or lower affecting it. This is speech, not magic: the target must be able to hear and understand you, and it does not work on a creature that cannot be reasoned with.

cinderfall.incomplete: Bucket 3 (limited-use activated action) and, independently, reducing a condition's numeric value (rather than granting/removing it wholesale) has no rule-element precedent anywhere in pf2e-source -- both stand-firm.json and fear-no-law-fear-no-one.json (the closest real analogs, both reducing frightened by a stated amount) ship rules: []. Two independent reasons this can't be more than flavor text today.
